entities.summary: Gustavo Heide is a Brazilian professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 142 achieved on 19 August 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 197 achieved on 2 October 2023. He is currently the No. 6 singles player from Brazil.
